categories.main_business_segments: Kailong High Technology operates primarily in five business segments: exhaust after-treatment systems for engines, heat management systems for new energy vehicles, silicon carbide new materials, automotive inspection and testing services, and VOCs (volatile organic compounds) pollution control. The company serves commercial vehicles, non-road mobile machinery, ships, and industrial exhaust gas treatment sectors. It also develops catalytic converters and related components for diesel and natural gas engines, as well as heat management products for electric vehicles and energy storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including SCR (Selective Catalytic Reduction), DPF (Diesel Particulate Filter), ASC (Ammonia Slip Catalyst), and DOC (Diesel Oxidation Catalyst) for exhaust after-treatment. It uses recrystallized silicon carbide technology for DPF carriers and is developing aluminum/silicon carbide composite brake discs for lightweight and high-performance braking. Heat management products incorporate intelligent thermal management units, high-voltage coolant heaters, and PTC heating modules. Manufacturing involves continuous forming, microwave drying, vacuum sintering, laser perforation, and automated assembly lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kailong's primary customers include engine manufacturers and vehicle OEMs in the commercial vehicle sector, non-road machinery producers, shipbuilders, and industrial enterprises requiring VOCs treatment. The company supplies both domestic and international clients, including major firms in Russia, India, Germany, Spain, Korea, and Belarus. Its products are integrated into diesel and natural gas engines, new energy commercial vehicles, and industrial pollution control systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, and subsidiaries across Jiangsu and Hunan provinces. It actively pursues international markets, focusing on Europe, Southeast Asia, Central Asia, Russia, India, Spain, Germany, and Korea. It participates in international automotive and parts exhibitions to expand its overseas presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kailong High Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive and industrial pollution control supply chain. It manufactures core components such as catalytic converters, DPF carriers, heat management modules, and provides integrated systems to engine and vehicle manufacturers. It also offers third-party inspection and testing services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in emission control and thermal management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation with a focus on meeting increasingly stringent emission standards (China VI, EU7). R&D priorities include development of advanced SCR systems, high-porosity ceramic carriers, aluminum/silicon carbide brake discs, and heat management products for new energy vehicles. It invests in digital manufacturing, quality control, and collaborates with universities for new material development. The company also pursues international market expansion and integration of its five business segments to create new growth drivers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of exhaust after-treatment systems, heat management modules, new materials, and catalytic converters to engine manufacturers and vehicle OEMs. The company also earns income from third-party automotive inspection and testing services. Sales are mostly on a direct sales basis, with products delivered against customer orders under annual framework agreements. It does not engage in subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kailong High Technology is positioned as a leading domestic player with a comprehensive product portfolio and integrated industry chain in the automotive emission control and heat management sectors. It competes with other Chinese and international suppliers of exhaust after-treatment systems and catalytic materials. Its early R&D achievements and patent portfolio provide competitive advantages, especially in silicon carbide materials and integrated SCR systems. The company faces intensified competition due to market contraction and rising new energy vehicle penetration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 578 million, a 44.5% decline from 2023, primarily due to reduced commercial vehicle sales and pricing pressure. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 276.5 million. Total assets stood at RMB 1.28 billion, down 24.6% year-over-year. The company’s R&D investment increased to RMB 68 million, representing 11.76% of revenue. Despite recent losses, the company maintains significant scale with ongoing investments in technology and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kailong High Technology emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop solutions for engine exhaust after-treatment, combining core technologies like SCR, DPF, and advanced catalytic materials. Its silicon carbide DPF carriers and aluminum/silicon carbide brake discs offer superior thermal resistance, durability, and lightweight benefits, addressing new energy vehicle demands. The company’s integrated heat management systems enhance battery and cabin thermal control, improving vehicle performance and safety. Strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and quality certifications differentiate it in a competitive market.
